name: AI image generation
intro: Where generation truly follows the prompt and the avatar looks like you, and where the result is not what was promised.

apps.title: Gencraft AI Image Generator
apps.verdict: A generator with a strong community and custom model builder. The main drawback is heavy-handed censorship that blocks even swimsuits and women's legs, plus a free tier cut from 10 to 5 generations per day.
apps.loved: Active community, custom model builder, great for book character creation, family-safe content
apps.weak: Censorship applied unevenly by gender (male swimwear passes, female swimwear banned), daily limit halved without warning, realistic mode looks flat, limb deformations increased after recent updates
apps.whoFor: Authors and illustrators who need a safe generator for characters without NSFW content, with community access and custom models

apps.title: Neko AI - Anime Art Generator
apps.verdict: An anime generator with relaxed limits on adult content. Works well with properly written tags, but after updates some users lose their accounts and purchased credits.
apps.loved: Prompt freedom, tag responsiveness, daily free credits, built-in art publishing system
apps.weak: Consumable grant lock bug causes some users to lose access and credits after payment, slow support, style filters sometimes break without refunding credits
apps.whoFor: Anime art fans and character creators for stories who are willing to learn the tag system

quotes.text: Honestly you can get great images out of this. But if you wanna use the Ai chat features they keep ruining the experience of them it seems they keep ruining a good thing by changing those. The image generator for this app is excellent quality though.

apps.title: PixAI - AI Anime Art Generator
apps.verdict: A solid anime generator with a rich LoRA library and a generous free credit system. The main problem is erratic moderation: SFW images get blocked while other users' inappropriate content stays up.
apps.loved: Huge library of ready-made characters and LoRA, daily free credits, fast generation, web version works better than mobile
apps.weak: Inconsistent content filtering, no way to delete images from your library, fewer models on mobile than on the site, other users' policy-violating images are not removed
apps.whoFor: Anime art fans who want a flexible system with LoRA without a big financial commitment

apps.title: Artist.ai - AI Art Generator
apps.verdict: One of the more honest AI art generators with a beginner-friendly interface, but paid avatars get stuck in generation for days and saved galleries periodically disappear.
apps.loved: Most free features work well. Good for fantasy illustration without precise requirements. Beginners find it easy to pick up.
apps.weak: Paid avatars enter generation and do not appear for days. Saved work vanishes repeatedly, and support does not respond. Poor accuracy on text and facial details.
apps.whoFor: Beginners exploring AI art who want a free visual playground without precise prompting

apps.title: Ideogram AI - Image Generator
apps.verdict: Ideogram is known for best-in-class text and logo rendering in images. But the mobile app is a thin browser wrapper plagued by Cloudflare pop-ups that block paying subscribers.
apps.loved: Sharp text and logo rendering, rich image detail, users return daily
apps.weak: Cloudflare pop-ups lock paid accounts for a week, the app is just a webview with no native features, delete and privacy controls don't work even on paid tiers, color prompts are ignored
apps.whoFor: Logo designers and typographers willing to work through a browser rather than a native app

apps.title: Kling AI: AI Image&Video Maker
apps.verdict: One of the best AI video platforms for visual quality, but expensive and unpredictable: prompts are often misinterpreted, filters block neutral content, and credits burn for nothing.
apps.loved: High visual quality in videos, ability to animate your own images, good consistency by market standards
apps.weak: Very expensive monetization, unstable prompt following, aggressive content filters, generation queues, text in video is unreadable
apps.whoFor: Content creators and visual experimenters willing to spend a significant budget on AI video

quotes.text: Rarely gets the prompt right I've had to waste so much money on this app today's my last day using it

I'm paying for a subscription and also purchasing additional credits because I'm using more credits than necessary to re-create videos that are misinterpreted. Overall, the best ai app I've used so far, if they rethink the credit usage it would be better.

This app is ridiculously expensive, and it was already going downhill before this update. The filters are so absurd that not even ChatGPT can help write prompts that consistently work anymore. I keep wasting credits on generations that get blocked or produce unusable results.
The results are good IF you manage to get in the queue, I can wait for a few days so just queue me instead of making me look for the right time to generate
I tried it out and hadn't made me one video and the video was pretty good but the text on it wasn't even legible and was misspelled horribly

apps.title: MyMood AI: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: An AI avatar generator with a wide range of styles and cosplay that regular users genuinely enjoy, but it consistently fails on monetization: deceptive trials, unfair charges, and credits that never arrive create a toxic purchase experience.
apps.loved: Wide style library including cosplay and anime. Gives 20 free credits daily so you can try without paying. Support sometimes responds quickly. Results are impressive when the app is stable.
apps.weak: Credits don't arrive as promised. App crashes immediately. Avatars don't reproduce hair or eye color even when explicitly specified. Reports of $499 lifetime followed by a demand for another $99/month. The feedback button doesn't work.
apps.whoFor: Users who want to see themselves in different art styles and are sticking to the free daily credits only, not paying for a subscription

quotes.text: Aún subiendo muchas fotos de tu avatar, el avatar que crea la app no es preciso. Cambia cosas como el color de el cabello, el color de los ojos. Te da la opción para que selecciones el color y cambiarlo pero aún así no hace el cambio en el avatar.

apps.title: GoArt - AI Art Image Generator
apps.verdict: A set of style filters with an aggressive credit model. The artistic effects work, but constant ads and credits that vanish into thin air reduce the enjoyment to almost nothing.
apps.loved: Wide selection of art styles, fast generation, ability to use for free by watching ads
apps.weak: Credits disappear without a trace, rendering slows down on paid subscriptions, weak prompt adherence, support is unreachable
apps.whoFor: Casual users who want to turn a photo into a 'Monet painting' once and don't mind burning credits

apps.title: AI Art Generator - UniDream AI
apps.verdict: An image generation app with solid capabilities that degraded after a monetization overhaul and tighter censorship. Strengths include a diverse feature set (outpainting, object removal), weaknesses are unpredictable filtering and broken promises.
apps.loved: High-quality results in fantasy and anime styles, outpainting and object removal, cross-platform account across Mac and iPhone, no forced review before use
apps.weak: Stopped working without explanation, censorship blocks harmless requests, users pushed to a subscription after purchasing lifetime access, generated text has errors, prompts frequently ignored
apps.whoFor: Artists and fantasy art fans willing to tolerate unpredictable filtering

apps.title: Pose: AI Photo Video Generator
apps.verdict: An entertainment app for animating photos to trending dances and effects. The credit system is structured so the free trial lets you do almost nothing.
apps.loved: Quickly creates fun photo animations. Viral format, works well for social media. Easy entry point into AI animation.
apps.weak: Free trial gives 1,000 credits while any action costs 3,000. Several users report $80/month charges with no way to reach support. Faces in animations don't always match the original.
apps.whoFor: One-off social media fun with photos. Not for regular use due to expensive credits.

quotes.text: It makes pretty decent AI. The only issues are that it uses a credit system, everything costs wayyyyy too much, and it gives you a 3 day free trial but you can't even make anything with the credits you're given. Everything costs 3000 credits and you're given 1000.

apps.title: Toonapp: AI Photo & Video Art
apps.verdict: Photo-to-cartoon and trending video effects. The output quality is fine for entertainment, but a $12.99/week subscription ($675/year) is wildly out of proportion to the product's value.
apps.loved: Fun cartoon versions of photos. Trending dance videos with the user's face get laughs from everyone. Very simple to use.
apps.weak: Subscription charges immediately after the trial without a warning, including for users who never opened the app. $12.99 per week with an annual cost of $675 is a clear value mismatch. Results are 'fun but not realistic'.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who wants a one-time laugh with cartoon photos. Cancel the subscription immediately after first use.

apps.title: ReShoot: AI Photos & Edits
apps.verdict: An AI photo editor with reliable background and shadow removal, but after a few edits it stops following instructions and alters your face with any enhancement attempt.
apps.loved: Background removal works consistently. Shadow removal is effective. Simple interface works well for beginners.
apps.weak: After 2-3 edits it ignores new instructions and wastes credits. Alters facial features during restoration. A $70 annual subscription doesn't top up credits on schedule. No support.
apps.whoFor: Users who need simple one-off edits: remove a background, a shadow, or a random object

quotes.text: I paid $70 for the annual option, and it just (allegedly) replenishes your account once a week with 200 credits. They don't actually replenish your account each week! There's no customer support. The photo edits are hit or miss.

It works fairly well the first couple of times you ask it to do something, and then beyond that point, it doesn't listen to what you say. You waste money on literally no change to the picture. It is SUPER frustrating. I ended up just taking the photos I tried to edit to ChatGPT and got a better result.
App kept changing facial features and other things I didn't want when I was just trying to remove background noose. Tried many times! Gave up and deleted app

apps.title: Leonardo.Ai - Image Generator
apps.verdict: A powerful web image generation tool that degraded in UI, censorship, and stability after its acquisition by Canva. Video generation (Veo 3) frequently errors out and tokens disappear for nothing.
apps.loved: Real model power when it works, impressive results. Canvas with adjustable influence strength (30-95) is convenient for iterative editing. The platform's historical reputation.
apps.weak: Constant Veo 3 errors with no token refunds. Censorship blocks even neutral prompts. iPad text-input bug. Auth breaks when logging in through the mobile app. Tokens vanish without explanation.
apps.whoFor: Power users who already know the platform and are willing to tolerate instability for quality results on the web version

quotes.text: Be clear with prompts, the downside and would have got five stars but sometimes I need to keep redoing the photo in steps because it won't generate the right image and uses tokens to keep redoing

Been using this platform for years now, when it works it's one of my favorite. However the censorship basically prevents you from doing much with it. It's one of the most censored platforms out there. I had several words banned again today in a description trying to make things more modest.

I have had this app for 2-3 years now. The prompt adherence is getting worse. After the update it is hard to generate anything worth saving. Also they didn't roll over my tokens this month. I had approx. 30,000 tokens in March. They didn't roll over.

apps.title: FakeMe: Face Swap AI Photo App
apps.verdict: The best face swap in the category for core function quality, but reliability suffers: hangs in the queue, crashes on multi-face swaps, video is capped at 1 minute, and ads have an uncloseable X button.
apps.loved: Basic photo swap works accurately and realistically, daily free tokens, wide selection of video templates
apps.weak: Multi-face swap crashes, video capped at 1 minute for paying users, queue hangs for hours, ads won't close, output video loses quality compared to the source
apps.whoFor: Quick entertainment photo swaps for social media. Not suitable for video work or group scenes.

apps.title: Spellai - AI Art Maker
apps.verdict: A hybrid of AI character chat and image generation that has lost its direction. Long-time users complain about quality degradation and hypercensorship, newer users praise the character interactivity.
apps.loved: Large character library, daily free crystals (200), animating your own drawings works well for some users
apps.weak: Censorship blocks harmless content (hugs, swimwear), short AI memory (context resets after about 10 messages), image quality degraded after December 2025 updates
apps.whoFor: Users who want AI character chat rather than a pure image generator

apps.title: Photo Lab — AI Image Editor
apps.verdict: Photo filters with AI effects that have been around for years. Strong point is the style library. Main issues: opaque pricing, app crashes while working, and faces become unrecognizable after AI processing.
apps.loved: Large selection of filters and effects. Fast styled photo creation. Long track record.
apps.weak: Three 'Premium' tiers at different prices with no clear distinction in features. App crashes when selecting photos for some users. Faces become unrecognizable after AI processing. Users report photos appearing in Google without consent.
apps.whoFor: Quick style experiments when face accuracy doesn't matter. Not for professional work.

apps.title: AI Photo Video Editor, Enhance
apps.verdict: An editor with photo restoration and AI video: great at improving old photos, but requires you to pay separately for both a subscription and credits, and video frequently distorts faces.
apps.loved: Old photo restoration is impressive, varied feature set, videos come out well when the system isn't glitching
apps.weak: Dual monetization (subscription plus credits), faces in videos often don't match the original, credits burn on errors, confusing interface
apps.whoFor: Anyone who wants to restore old family photos or create a one-off AI video but doesn't plan to use it daily

apps.title: Adobe Firefly AI Video & Photo
apps.verdict: A professional Adobe AI tool with strong capabilities (Omni 3, timelines, sound effects), but a confusing credit system, regular feature outages, and weak prompt adherence make it unreliable even for paying users.
apps.loved: Multi-scenario setup via Omni 3. Sound effects. 2K editing without spending credits. Integration with the Adobe ecosystem for those already working in it.
apps.weak: Credits burn in 30 minutes of testing. Image-to-video is unavailable under high load even though you pay monthly. Timeouts charge credits with no result. Images don't follow prompts. Pro Plus is constantly unavailable. The app feels unfinished.
apps.whoFor: Adobe professionals who already have a Creative Cloud subscription and need a quick AI draft, not precise prompt following

quotes.text: Images look good but, it doesn't really do what you ask and then when you try to clarify it just basically feeds you back the exact same image again with almost unnoticeable tweaks.

apps.title: PicToVid: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A photo animation app that impresses when it works, but stability is catastrophic: videos can't be downloaded, and the lifetime subscription doesn't deliver the promised unlimited templates.
apps.loved: When it works, the output looks beautiful. Animations of nature scenes are convincing.
apps.weak: Videos generate but can't be downloaded (an X appears instead of a button), templates don't open, support is in Chinese, lifetime promises unlimited but delivers a weekly credit allotment
apps.whoFor: Patient users who have time to deal with errors and don't expect refunds

apps.title: Magnific - AI Video & Image
apps.verdict: A Freepik platform with a rich set of models and tools, but a widespread subscription activation bug via the App Store. Real value exists in the web version, the mobile app works significantly worse.
apps.loved: Large selection of AI models, video and images in one place, adjustable moderation, solid web version functionality
apps.weak: App Store payments often fail to activate the plan, support doesn't respond, date filtering is broken, uploading images from files doesn't work, credits don't carry over between billing periods
apps.whoFor: Content creators and designers willing to work through the web version without relying on the mobile app

apps.title: Tattoo AI - Tattoo Design
apps.verdict: A specialized tattoo sketch generator with real professional use by tattoo artists, but weak execution: styles are indistinguishable, complex imagery gets ignored, and ads are aggressive.
apps.loved: Body preview feature is useful for client consultations, fast mockups for clients, simple designs come out reasonably well
apps.weak: Complex and specific requests produce the same generic output regardless of style, style selection barely affects the result, ads after every action, adds random faces to animal photos
apps.whoFor: Tattoo artists for quick client consultations and anyone who wants a rough sketch of a simple design

quotes.text: As a tattoo artist, the ai tattoo tool helps me show clients quick design mockups. The tattoo placement feature is accurate enough for consultations and the tattoo creator saves time

The ai engine isn't accurate at all. It gives pretty generic ai slop regardless of your prompt. Type in a hyper specific idea with different art styles from Norse mythology to world of Warcraft, Harry Potter, or Christianity imagery. They have differences between them all though they all look the same.

After several attempts to get the app to create a watercolor tattoo of my little Frenchi's face, I gave up because the app keeps taking the picture and adding one or two more faces to her face. Like she's a three faced Frenchie. The faces are of other animals like cats and wolves.
kinda fun but it wouldn't let me watch an ad and also it leaves out some details i put in but its still fun!

apps.title: Visify: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: An avatar generator with aggressive monetization: charges after canceling the trial and advertises features that don't exist in the app.
apps.loved: Fast generation, variety of styles, some users are happy with the photo quality
apps.weak: Unauthorized charges after cancellation, ads don't match the actual content, limited style library, no prompt editing
apps.whoFor: Users who want simple themed avatars and are comfortable paying per photo

quotes.text: Downloaded after seeing Instagram ads showing birthday photos with age-specific elements. These features do not exist in the app. Support confirmed ads show examples only. Misleading advertising.

apps.title: Color Pop AI: Coloring Book
apps.verdict: A coloring book with AI filters, not an image generator. Ads every 5-30 seconds make the core mechanic unplayable. Paid access is required for almost any basic tool.
apps.loved: Large selection of images to color. Relaxing format when there are no ads.
apps.weak: Ads literally after every action, including lifting a pencil. Most tools and colors require watching an ad or making a payment. Automatic subscription on first launch without clear consent.
apps.whoFor: Kids whose parents are willing to pay to remove the ads. Adults with any quality expectations should look elsewhere.

apps.title: Photoleap: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A photo editor with AI features that systematically moves previously free capabilities behind a paywall with every update. Image generation is unstable and follows prompts poorly.
apps.loved: Wide set of photo editing tools. Good for adding text layers and overlays. Specific prompts occasionally produce decent results.
apps.weak: After every update something previously free becomes paid. App crashes when loading photos on some devices. AI generation is unstable: often just pastes a face into someone else's photo. Text in generated images doesn't work. Popular features removed without notice.
apps.whoFor: Mobile photo editing with text layers if you're willing to pay a subscription. Not recommended as an AI generator.

quotes.text: Decent photo editing, but AI generating leaves much to be desired. Very hit or miss.
I like the app a lot but it's very disappointing that the text doesn't work, also I suggest if you give us more room to write our prompts because the range is very limited.

apps.title: PhotoApp - AI Photo Enhancer
apps.verdict: An AI photo enhancer with an unstable backend and aggressive monetization. When it works, colorization and old photo restoration are pleasant. When it doesn't, it can be down for weeks.
apps.loved: Old photo colorization, hairstyle changes, resolution enhancement
apps.weak: Backend goes down for hours and days, subscription cancellation requires third-party workarounds with no feedback, results sometimes look worse than the original
apps.whoFor: Family archive enthusiasts who can tolerate an unreliable service

apps.title: LightX: AI Generator & Editor
apps.verdict: A feature-rich editor that degraded after updates: text-to-image stopped following prompts, familiar tools disappeared, and the monetization is dual-layered.
apps.loved: Layer compositing tool, rich font selection, AI tools are good when they work
apps.weak: Text-to-image produces random results instead of what's requested, updates keep breaking existing features, dual charges (subscription plus credits), frequent crashes
apps.whoFor: Social media users who need a multi-function editor and are willing to navigate a complex interface

quotes.text: When using the AI text to image or Image to Image features they work great usually the first couple tries and then the rendering gets stuck in a pattern and fails to take additional adjustments.

The text to image use to be top tier, you can type in a prompt and select different styles to change it to until it fits what you're looking for, now even when you switch the style filter to fit what you want the AI gives you random pics. It's terrible now!

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: ImgAI
apps.verdict: An image generator with acceptable visual quality but an extremely limited free tier and misleading 'unlimited' advertising. Only worthwhile for users who need one or two images and nothing more.
apps.loved: A few users note good visual results and a comfortable onboarding experience
apps.weak: Hard paywall after 3-10 free images, real daily limit even on paid tiers (5-10/day instead of advertised unlimited), saved albums disappear
apps.whoFor: The occasional user who needs one or two nice images every few days

apps.title: AI Art Generator，Photo Enhance
apps.verdict: A multi-function generator with photo restoration, artistic filters, and text-to-image. The watercolor mode gets praise, but portrait restoration blurs details, and text-to-image ignores prompts.
apps.loved: Watercolor and artistic photo styles, easy filter application
apps.weak: Photo restoration produces blurry, noisy output and makes people look older, prompts ignored (dragon wings remain even after asking to remove them), no high-resolution export
apps.whoFor: Users who want to quickly add an artistic style to a photo, not precise text-based generation

apps.title: AI Art Generator - Video-Art-X
apps.verdict: Once a decent generator with Ghibli and anime styles, destroyed by an update that broke the old Pro plan and added a forced expensive subscription. Isolated reports of unstoppable charges.
apps.loved: Good Ghibli style, some users got high-quality results, responsive support when credits were lost
apps.weak: Update broke the old Pro plan without compensation, filtering blocks acceptable content, internal generation errors, unable to cancel subscription
apps.whoFor: Ghibli art fans who are okay with instability and an expensive subscription

apps.title: Arvin®: AI Product Photo Maker
apps.verdict: An AI product photo generator for small business with a good concept but poor execution. Logos have typos, products get distorted, and scaling doesn't work.
apps.loved: Fast background generation for clothing, variety of scenes for product shots
apps.weak: Logos generate with errors, product scale is wrong, subscription cancellation is deliberately hidden, the app radically changed its feature set after purchase
apps.whoFor: Small businesses that need a quick simple background shot of a product without a logo

quotes.text: This is a great app. Especially love the videos generated. However, I'm removing 2 stars since the image or product is not true to size in videos or photos and there is no feature for editing product sizes on models. Products are also sometimes distorted to fit models.

How do you create logos and misspell words. You need a spell check. Also if I spell the word correctly in my prompt where are you pulling the spelling from? Then it doesn't recreate the design you are considering with the correct spelling so you lose that design.
The product the app generated exceeds my expectations. Time was fast, about 50 seconds. The background is but my white garment display well on it. It's a true tool to recommend for fashion designers.

I have a business and I wanted to try this new app. Every-time I try to make a video with my product, it will change my logos every to something that is not what I added. So, while it makes cool graphics, if it changes your stuff and you can't use it, it is pointless.

apps.title: starryai - AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: An AI art generator that worked well as a community tool, but a series of updates cut free credits, broke purchase transfers, and added overly aggressive filtering.
apps.loved: Rich selection of art styles, ability to create custom styles, simple interface
apps.weak: Free credits cut from 5 to 1 per day, purchased credits vanish upon registration, censorship blocks neutral female imagery, results often stray far from the prompt
apps.whoFor: Artists and AI art enthusiasts who want to experiment with styles and are willing to pay for credits

quotes.text: This app used to be my absolute favorite for art, but now it's obsolete compared to other apps, and worst of all this app has become absolutely useless when editing pictures of women. Every single attempt to make anything having to do with a female is being rejected for safety filters. Fully clothed.

This app used amazing. Five free lumens a day. Collect for 10 days and you could make your own style. Participate in community art challenges. The past few times I've been back to it it has gotten so bad and it's become nothing more than an Instagram Post Promoter.

apps.title: AI Image Generator ~ DALI Art
apps.verdict: An AI generator stuck in an infinite loading loop for many users. When it works, results are imprecise but occasionally decent. A paid subscription often doesn't remove the limitations.
apps.loved: Fast generation when it works, first results occasionally impress, free credits are available
apps.weak: Generator hangs and shows jokes instead of images, prompts execute inaccurately, slow loading, can't delete images from the collection, paid subscription doesn't always unlock features
apps.whoFor: Casual users who need one quick generation and get lucky with the server

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: ARTA
apps.verdict: An AI avatar generator that gets worse with every update. Once produced decent portraits, now generation hangs at 99%, and the output face almost never resembles the original.
apps.loved: Variety of styles and animations when things go well, wide range of scenes
apps.weak: Generation hangs and never finishes, face doesn't match the uploaded photo, paid credits don't arrive, models removed without compensation
apps.whoFor: Anyone who wants a one-time experiment without planning to use it long-term

quotes.text: I can upload a full face photo and the likeness is never generated. I cancelled the subscription.

apps.title: RunwayML
apps.verdict: A professional video generation tool with genuinely high-quality output, but catastrophically expensive for regular users: a $15 subscription runs out after two short clips.
apps.loved: When the prompt works, animation quality is above average. Understands basic instructions quickly.
apps.weak: $15 = 2 clips of 5 seconds each. Prompts ignored: background motion not added, descriptions violated. Credits charged even for failed generations. Text in video is unreadable. Gen 3 removed without notice.
apps.whoFor: Professionals with a budget who need quality over quantity. Not for high-volume content creation.

quotes.text: this app promises me free generations after it messes up my prompts twice, and then charges me AGAIN. it's done this 3 times and i've wasted 1200 ($12 in credits) trying to get it to make one video even semi-properly.

I paid 15$ for subscription to make a short video, I wrote a script for the video, it made this video from 7 slides for 5 sec each slide, the text that I put in the script the program messed it up and made it unreadable, after all 7 slides was ready I had no more credits to do anything else.

apps.title: DaVinci - Image Generator AI
apps.verdict: An AI image and video generator with an unstable backend and billing problems. Faces come out unnatural, text in images has errors, and the subscription attempts to charge again after cancellation.
apps.loved: Simple interface, occasionally captures the right mood in art
apps.weak: Stops generating after updates, faces look unnatural, text in images has spelling errors, multiple confusing pricing plans, attempted re-charges after cancellation
apps.whoFor: Casual curious users not planning to use it regularly

quotes.text: I'm not too happy with my pro subscription. It sometimes takes 50 tries to get something right. Especially if you want a text included. Because most of your words are spelled wrong, over and over.

apps.title: WOMBO Dream - AI Art Generator
apps.verdict: A pioneer of mobile AI generation that has degraded to near-scam territory. Five free generations per day, $99/year for a subscription, and broken login for existing users describe most reviews.
apps.loved: Historically the first simple generator with abstract styles. A minimal prompt gives unpredictable, interesting results. The input image strength editing tool was useful.
apps.weak: Only 5 generations per day on the free plan. Deleted all users' old generations. Does not honor purchased lifetime subscriptions. Images often ignore specific prompt details: wrong hair color, beard instead of clean-shaven. Video generation is blocked by content restrictions even on neutral requests.
apps.whoFor: Was for AI art beginners. Not recommended now due to product degradation and broken commitments to existing users.

quotes.text: I asked for a single man in a single panel, to have white hair and be clean shaven. The four candidates returned all had multiple panels, each containing a man with black hair and a thick black beard. I spent at least an hour trying to get any pictures that didn't completely ignore some provision

I paid the $20 to unlock video creation. The vast majority of my generations will fail due to content restrictions, and I'm not even trying to generate anything inappropriate, it's just that when the AI DECIDES to flag something.

apps.title: Wonder - AI Art Generator
apps.verdict: One of the first AI art generators, which betrayed early buyers by switching to a credit model after selling lifetime subscriptions. Landscapes are passable, people and complex scenes don't work.
apps.loved: Landscapes and settings, recognition of art styles for users who know art history
apps.weak: People come out poorly, prompts are largely ignored when working with a source photo, lifetime subscriptions cancelled without refunds, accounts deleted without notice
apps.whoFor: Anyone looking for landscape stylization who hasn't paid for a lifetime plan and just wants to try it

quotes.text: Not that much option I guess when making the pictures they didn't come out how I wanted, I wanted mini bikes and it kept giving me motorcycles and I kept putting how I wanted them positioned and it just put them together everytime.

I purchased the lifetime membership fee once when it was $40 and it gave me unlimited ai generating but now I'm all of a sudden having to use coins? When did this happen and how can I go back to my actual pro account

apps.title: Dream Photo: AI Generator
apps.loved: Visually attractive pre-made wallpapers and animated backgrounds.
apps.weak: No real prompt-based generation. The app asked users to leave 5 stars for unlocking content and then didn't deliver on the promise. Almost all content is paid. $7 per week for a wallpaper gallery. Inappropriate for the 12+ audience it targets.
apps.whoFor: Only for users who want attractive pre-made wallpapers and are willing to pay a subscription without expecting any AI generation.

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: Remake AI
apps.verdict: An AI portrait generator that almost never recognizes the source face: adds hair to bald users, changes weight against settings, takes 30 minutes to generate, and charges credits even for bad results.
apps.loved: Occasionally produces decent professional-looking shots, many style and background options
apps.weak: Output face often doesn't resemble the original, requires a $5.99 pack on top of an annual subscription, credits charged for failed generations, support unreachable, wait time up to 30 minutes
apps.whoFor: Not suitable for free exploration, too unreliable for paying users

quotes.text: Laces not похоже на оригинал, нужно платить $5.99 за пак поверх годовой подписки, кредиты списываются за провальные генерации, поддержка недоступна, ожидание до 30 минут

apps.title: Gram AI: Art Creator
apps.verdict: An AI avatar generator that promises realistic likeness but typically produces people of a different appearance or race, with artifacts and masculine features on female photos.
apps.loved: Certain anime styles occasionally capture real facial features, there are interesting themed packs
apps.weak: Avatars don't resemble the uploaded photo, fewer images delivered than promised, free trial charges money without warning, support doesn't respond
apps.whoFor: Not worth buying until face recognition accuracy improves dramatically

apps.title: AI Art Generator
apps.verdict: An abandoned app that stopped working normally after recent updates: constant crashes, lost lifetime subscriptions, disappeared features. Was good two years ago.
apps.loved: Previously supported reference images and delivered high quality. The AI art generator concept was implemented clearly.
apps.weak: Constant crashes after updates, lifetime subscriptions stopped working, features disappeared or changed, no developer updates, no racial diversity in generation output
apps.whoFor: No one, the app is effectively abandoned.

apps.title: Momo: AI Photo & Video Maker
apps.verdict: An AI avatar app with bait-and-switch monetization. One in five results looks acceptable, while body and ethnicity change arbitrarily.
apps.loved: Variety of themed templates, professional headshots occasionally come out well
apps.weak: Coins charged with no result, body in the photo doesn't match the original, ethnicity and hair color change without being asked, the promised unlimited access turns into a trap
apps.whoFor: Hard to recommend to anyone given the current quality and payment scheme

quotes.text: It keeps asking me to upload photos but doesn't actually make images from the uploaded photos. 75% of the time it made me the wrong ethnicity with the wrong hair color.

apps.title: GIO - AI Photoshoot Generator
apps.verdict: AI photo sessions with a solid visual foundation, but a blatantly predatory model: the subscription doesn't include photo sessions, each one is paid separately, and errors charge credits with no result.
apps.loved: Some photos look realistic, the idea of professional portraits without a photographer is appealing
apps.weak: Double billing (subscription plus credits per photo), frequent crashes on upload, body in the photo doesn't match the real user, ads show non-existent features
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone in its current form due to opaque billing

quotes.text: It creates great images but they are not accurate unless you are a skinny person. I am a curvy girl and didn't want pics that look like I'm anorexic. There is no options to ask for it to generates more authentic looking photo or video.
Says free trial, really charged 9.99. Only lets you do one photo shoot a week. Why am I paying for limited use?

apps.title: Celebrity Look Alike & AI Art
apps.verdict: A 'who do I look like' entertainment tool that charges $17.99 per week for unstable matches, misidentifies gender, and produces different results from the same photo every time. Not worth it for entertainment or accuracy.
apps.loved: The concept is fun, and when it hilariously gets it wrong that's entertaining in itself.
apps.weak: Requires payment before showing any result. $17.99/week and features still don't work after paying. Misidentifies gender even with long hair and pink clothing. Results aren't reproducible, the same photo gives different matches. Advertised as free.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended for anyone: the price sets expectations far too high for the quality delivered.

apps.title: AI Video Photo・DreamPix Editor
apps.verdict: An editor with an interesting style set that became a trap: terms change after payment, credits are cut every few months, and support goes silent.
apps.loved: Wide style and theme selection, occasionally produces vivid portraits, combines video and photo in one app
apps.weak: Credits cut from 7 to 5 to 3 per week after purchasing an annual plan, best themes removed without explanation, results often don't resemble the source photo, support doesn't respond
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone, terms change retroactively and generation quality is below free alternatives

apps.title: NFT Art Creator ·
apps.verdict: An NFT creator with a good idea but unstable execution. The NFT creation interface is simple, but MetaMask minting breaks, the gallery crashes, and there's no support.
apps.loved: Simple NFT art creation, low barrier to entry for crypto newcomers, handy tool for basic visual ideas
apps.weak: Gallery crashes when scrolling, MetaMask minting doesn't work, too many ads every 30 seconds, no instructions or support
apps.whoFor: NFT newcomers who want to try creating simple art without serious intent to sell it

apps.title: AI Art Generator & Logo - Hexa
apps.verdict: A logo and photo background generator with attractive marketing copy, but results don't match the prompt, coins vanish without a refund, and editing burns the balance for a nonexistent result.
apps.loved: The background swap concept for product photos is convenient for e-commerce, one logo example impressed a professional
apps.weak: Text in generations is consistently distorted, objects not accurately reproduced, a 250-coin animation returns an error, support doesn't return coins, double billing documented
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone until basic bugs with coins and generation accuracy are fixed

apps.title: AI Art : Photo Video Generator
apps.verdict: A generator with interesting styles but broken infrastructure: the server is constantly overloaded, only 2 free attempts, AI Avatar requires separate payment on top of a subscription, and a $79.99 lifetime purchase regularly resets.
apps.loved: Good at landscapes and abstract scenes, variety of styles
apps.weak: Server error on queue with no credit refund, only 2 free images, AI Avatar is a hidden extra charge, $79.99 lifetime resets, support doesn't answer emails
apps.whoFor: Artists and designers who need landscapes and fantasy scenes, only if they can find a stable server window

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: FaceOff
apps.verdict: A photo/avatar generator that without warning migrated to a new platform, voiding existing subscriptions. Image quality is described as adequate, but dual-paywall monetization and shutting down the old app are serious trust violations.
apps.loved: Realistic photos with good source material, some users praise character accuracy with the right set of photos
apps.weak: Migration to Clone AI without transferring subscriptions, $80 annual subscription voided, hands generate with distorted fingers, hair color and race change arbitrarily
apps.whoFor: This app should no longer be trusted given its history of forced migration

apps.title: DALL E 3 AI Art Generator
apps.verdict: A third-party wrapper around someone else's model using the DALL-E 3 brand name: credits disappear if the screen locks during generation, $20-100/year required upfront, and results are weaker than other free tools.
apps.loved: Occasionally handles simple requests, interface is more familiar than web-based tools
apps.weak: Credits vanish if the phone locks during generation, heavy censorship on neutral requests, very little for free, results described as unrealistic by users who tried other apps
apps.whoFor: Not recommended, the real DALL-E is available more cheaply through ChatGPT

apps.title: Anime Art - AI Art Generator
apps.verdict: An anime generator with a non-functional core feature: it doesn't create anime, crashes on basic actions, shows adult content ads on launch, and a lifetime purchase doesn't protect against failures.
apps.loved: Image quality is good when the app doesn't crash, some styles do work
apps.weak: Crashes when opening basic tabs after an expensive purchase, doesn't generate anime style despite the name, aggressive adult content ads on launch, filters block neutral requests
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone in its current state

quotes.text: It doesn't make anime and it doesn't even make what you ask and you only get realistic style

I spent $169.99 USD to get the lifetime premium access to the app. Every single thing I do crashes the app now. If I open the character tab it crashes, if I try to generate my own image it crashes, if I try exploring other options it crashes.

apps.title: AI Painting: Generate Art Girl
apps.verdict: An image generator with virtually no prompt control, an ad after every action, and random explicit content appearing without being requested.
apps.loved: Some users like the visual output, especially the realistic style
apps.weak: Prompts ignored: wrong gender, extra characters, unrequested details added. Ad before every generation and when opening every variation. App crashes. Daily limit without warning.
apps.whoFor: Not suitable for serious work. Attracts users through NSFW content.

quotes.text: The app doesn't follow the prompts put into it. Not only does it not follow them it will add things not asked for. Prompt for two subjects you get two, three, one, or five.

apps.title: Aviart: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: Classic bait-and-switch: the app promises to animate photos of deceased relatives and create AI videos, charges $49.99 per year, then demands more money for every single action, and results look nothing like the ads.
apps.loved: The idea of bringing old photos of loved ones to life is emotionally compelling, some face animation effects work
apps.weak: After $49.99/year an extra fee is required for every video, results look radically different from the ads, strangers appear in photos, hair is added to bald people, support doesn't respond
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone in its current form

apps.title: Live Photo: AI Image Generator
apps.verdict: Photo animation promises more than it delivers. It generates clip-art instead of real faces, requires a subscription plus extra coins simultaneously, and the advertised features (specific movements, multiple people in frame) simply don't work.
apps.loved: A small number of users report a pleasant transformation effect on a lucky generation
apps.weak: Generated people don't resemble the original, dual monetization (subscription plus coins), advertised movements are absent, refunds not possible

apps.title: ImaginAI - AI Art & Video
apps.verdict: A video and avatar generator with an aggressive monetization trap: the subscription is advertised as unlimited but delivers only 2-3 generations before credits run out. Face transfer quality is weak.
apps.loved: The first two videos before credits run out are found fun by some, many styles
apps.weak: Bait-and-switch subscription documented by dozens of reviews, faces don't match the uploaded photos, yearly subscription also doesn't provide unlimited access, no refunds
apps.whoFor: Avoid until the monetization structure changes

quotes.text: Bait-and-switch: подписка рекламируется как безлимитная, но даёт 2-3 генерации до обнуления кредитов.

apps.title: AI Canvas - AI Image Generator
apps.verdict: An aggressive monetization scheme wrapped in an AI generator shell: the subscription doesn't include credits, every video costs extra, and the actual functionality after payment is either unavailable or extremely limited.
apps.loved: Interface is relatively straightforward, has some features for book design work
apps.weak: Subscription doesn't include real features, each video is an additional charge, app hangs and doesn't generate, interface is confusing, no refunds

apps.title: AI Video & Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A video and photo generator where generation hangs for hours, doesn't follow prompts, and requires payment for both a subscription and separate coins.
apps.loved: Some users got sharp, realistic images
apps.weak: Generation hangs for 12+ hours with no result. Prompts not followed: wrong gender, ethnicity, number of people. Subscription plus coins equals double payment. Trial period hard to cancel. No photo upload button.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended until stability improves substantially

quotes.text: The free trial was perfect because I could figure out that a generation could start at 1700 Wednesday and say it was still generating at 0821 Thursday. There's gotta be something better out there.

apps.title: AI Photo Video Generator: IRMO
apps.verdict: An AI avatar and short video generator with catastrophic monetization: $80 per year delivers only 5 three-second videos per week, and additional credits are also required. Support is silent, refunds refused.
apps.loved: Interesting effects and animated avatars. Anime filters attract younger users. The concept works at a high level.
apps.weak: 5 videos per week for $80/year feels like a scam. Dual monetization: subscription plus mandatory credits. Videos are 3 seconds. Text-to-video doesn't reproduce what's written in the prompt. Can't cancel a stalled processing job. Support doesn't respond. Watermark returned for users with an active subscription.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone in its current monetization form.

quotes.text: I've hit a snag. I've had a photo stuck in processing mode for 2 days, and no way to cancel it or stop it. I uninstalled and re-installed. I close the iPad down, I try other features, but nothing shifts the processing video and it's stopping me from doing anything else with the app.

apps.title: Ai Tattoo Ideas-Art Generator
apps.verdict: A tattoo idea generator with catastrophically poor generation quality and non-stop ads. Simple prompts produce random results, complex ones are completely ignored. Ad overload makes the free version unusable.
apps.loved: The concept of a themed generator for tattoo ideas is interesting in itself
apps.weak: AI ignores detailed prompts, gives the same result for different requests, ads every few seconds, UI bugs hide the create button behind the keyboard
apps.whoFor: No one at the current generation quality

apps.title: AI Photo Video Generator: AURA
apps.verdict: A generator that consistently creates the wrong person: it takes payment, generates a video with someone else's face, doesn't return credits, and doesn't answer emails, one of the worst promise-to-delivery ratios in the category.
apps.loved: Large selection of scenes and styles, lots of themed presets during holiday periods
apps.weak: Systematically generates the wrong person, credits charged for failed attempts with no compensation, dual billing (subscription plus coins), content disappears after holidays, support doesn't respond
apps.whoFor: Not recommended, high risk of losing money without getting the promised result

apps.title: AI Photo Generator - Fotorama
apps.verdict: An AI avatar generator with a full set of toxic practices: an annual subscription that requires separate coins for every action, ad-view coins that never post, and output that doesn't resemble the user (head on a stranger's body, wrong gender). After a model update, previously good results stopped reproducing.
apps.loved: Before the model update, some users got impressive creative photos. Simple interface.
apps.weak: Subscription plus mandatory coins equals double payment per action. Coins for watching ads are never credited. Generated photo doesn't resemble the user, wrong gender, someone else's body. Model degraded after update. Nothing can be done with the subscription alone without coins. One user bought an annual subscription and was never able to start working.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone.
